summary: Expanded the US-listed universe for direct naval/submarine/subsea niche-component exposure. The reference lane is anchored by L3Harris because it is an obvious undersea-warfare systems leader with towed-array sonar, submarine communications, and AUV launch/recovery exposure. The underfollowed lane surfaces Graham, Oceaneering, and Moog: smaller or less index-dominant industrial suppliers tied to Virginia/Columbia-class submarine components, SUBSAFE/submarine support equipment, and mission-critical naval actuation. This pass does not make any trading recommendation; it creates a Layer 1B candidate universe for later evidence verification, revenue-sizing, backlog quality, and valuation/market-pricing checks.
